Arrival & First Sights

Mon Mar 1 – Tue Mar 2 Tokyo Hilton Tokyo
Day 1 · Monday, March 1

Landing in Tokyo

Touch down at Haneda, ride the Tokyo Monorail toward Shinjuku, then check in and shake off the jet lag with a gentle evening stroll.

Kaiseki dinner at Kozue
Day 2 · Tuesday, March 2

A Slow Tokyo Day

Towering pines at Meiji Shrine, a slow walk through the Imperial Palace East Gardens, and time to breathe before race week.

Tempura at Tsunahachi
02

Marathon Week

Wed Mar 3 – Mon Mar 8 Tokyo Hotel Groove Shinjuku Sports Tours International
Day 3 · Wednesday, March 3

Into the Race Hotel

Move over to the Sports Tours race package hotel, meet the tour team, pick up essentials, and take a relaxed coffee break.

Days 4–6 · Thu Mar 4 – Sat Mar 6

Expo & Easy Days

Race packet pickup at Tokyo Big Sight with the group, a shakeout run if the legs feel right, the Nezu Museum, or a Sumida River cruise — and smart carb-loading all week.

Gyukatsu Motomura · Ichiran ramen
Day 7 · Sunday, March 7 · Race Day

The Big Event — 42.2 km

Early start at the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building, dedicated Sports Tours cheer zones along the course, the finish near Tokyo Station — and an exclusive post-race dinner to celebrate.

Post-race celebration dinner
Day 8 · Monday, March 8

Recovery & Ginza

Sleep in, ease sore muscles, slow afternoon souvenir hunting in Ginza, and a quiet visit to an upscale tea house.

03

Temples, Deer & Hot Springs

Mon Mar 8 – Wed Mar 10 Kyoto & Nara Ryokan with Onsen
Day 7 · Monday, March 8

Shinkansen to Kyoto

The Tokaido bullet train glides south in 2h15. Check into a traditional ryokan, soak marathon-tired muscles in a mineral onsen, and let kaiseki arrive course by course.

Kaiseki dinner in the ryokan
Day 8 · Tuesday, March 9

Nara & the Great Buddha

Todai-ji's colossal bronze Daibutsu inside one of the world's largest wooden buildings, bowing deer wandering Nara Park, then Kiyomizu-dera perched on the hillside with sweeping views.

Kyoto cuisine (yuba) near Gion
04

Peace, Torii & Okonomiyaki

Wed Mar 10 – Fri Mar 12 Hiroshima & Miyajima Back to Tokyo
Day 9 · Wednesday, March 10

Hiroshima & the Floating Torii

The solemn Peace Memorial Park and Museum, a short ferry across to Miyajima, and Itsukushima's vermilion torii rising from the water at high tide.

Okonomiyaki, griddled at the table
Day 10 · Thursday, March 11

The Long Way Back to Tokyo

Four unhurried hours on the shinkansen — books, naps, countryside views. A final night by Tokyo Station, and a farewell sushi counter in Ginza.

High-end sushi in Ginza
Day 11 · Friday, March 12

Homeward

A slow morning coffee, last-minute souvenirs, the Haneda monorail — and off to the airport.
